Regardless of the target, smite evil attacks automatically bypass any DR the creature might possess. In addition, while smite evil is in effect, the paladin gains a deflection bonus equal to her Charisma modifier (if any) to her AC against attacks made by the target of the smite. If the paladin targets a creature that is not evil, the smite is wasted with no effect. The smite evil effect remains until the target of the smite is dead or the next time the paladin rests and regains her uses of this ability. At 4th level, and at every three levels thereafter, the paladin may smite evil one additional time per day, as indicated on Table: Paladin, to a maximum of seven times per day at 19th level.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it create a cloud of thick smoke when it detonates. The cloud functions as @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.g33euis7yi9pwddy]{Fog Cloud}, filling an area equal to twice the bomb's splash radius for 1 round per level.

name: Snake Aspect
description: The snake is a sneaky and lethal foe who strikes unexpectedly with deadly effect, while avoiding opportune strikes made in return. Minor Form: You gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls when making attacks of opportunity and a +2 dodge bonus to your AC against attacks of opportunity. These bonuses increase to +4 at 8th level and +6 at 15th level. Major Form: Your shape changes to that of an emperor cobra (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 2 252). While in this form, you gain a base speed of 30 feet, a climb speed of 30 feet, a swim speed of 30 feet, lowlight vision, scent (30 feet), a bite attack (2d6 damage), and the Combat Reflexes feat. If you already have Combat Reflexes or your Dexterity score is not high enough to gain more attacks of opportunity from Combat Reflexes, you can instead make one additional attack of opportunity each round. At 8th level, you gain a +4 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Stealth checks. At 15th level, when you make an attack of opportunity with your bite attack, that attack also applies the following poison. Poison (Ex): Bite—injury; save Fort DC = 10 + half your shifter level + your Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Con damage; cure 2 consecutive saves. Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), tail slap (B)

name: Snatch Arrows
description: A ninja who selects this ninja trick gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.bHcqTC4Lf3aVl3VO]{Snatch Arrows} feat as a bonus feat. The ninja must have the @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.2aTFNMs3pW6nUBlr]{Improved Unarmed Strike} feat and the @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.ACEQfonKVqh0fwkK]{Deflect Arrows} feat before taking this trick.

name: Sneak Attack
description: If a character can catch an opponent when he is unable to defend himself effectively from her attack, she can strike a vital spot for extra damage. The character’s attack deals extra damage anytime her target would be denied a Dexterity bonus to AC (whether the target actually has a Dexterity bonus or not), or when the character flanks her target. This extra damage is 1d6 at 1st level, and increases by 1d6 every two class levels thereafter. Should the character score a critical hit with a sneak attack, this extra damage is not multiplied. Ranged attacks can count as sneak attacks only if the target is within 30 feet. With a weapon that deals nonlethal damage (like a @UUID[Compendium.pf1.weapons-and-ammo.mkwz0g7RwRwWkFkN]{sap}, @UUID[Compendium.pf1.weapons-and-ammo.OPTlPwKg2NyQAjhe]{whip}, or an unarmed strike), a character can make a sneak attack that deals nonlethal damage instead of lethal damage. She cannot use a weapon that deals lethal damage to deal nonlethal damage in a sneak attack, not even with the usual –4 penalty. The character must be able to see the target well enough to pick out a vital spot and must be able to reach such a spot. A character cannot sneak attack while striking a creature with concealment.

name: Solid Ground
description: The alchemist launches an explosive paste bomb that bonds with any earthen surface. Each application of this paste deals no damage and affects a 5-foot-cube of dirt, loose soil, or stone, transmuting the earth for a number of minutes equal to the alchemist’s level. Creatures cannot use burrow, earthmeld, or similar abilities (such as the meld into stone spell) while the ground remains transmuted in this way.

name: Soothing Performance
description: A bard of 12th level or higher can use his performance to create an effect equivalent to the mass cure serious wounds , using the bard’s level as the caster level . In addition, this performance removes the fatigued , sickened , and shaken condition from all those affected. Using this ability requires 4 rounds of continuous performance, and the targets must be able to see and hear the bard throughout the performance. Soothing performance relies on audible and visual components.

name: Sorcerer Bloodline
description: Each sorcerer has a source of magic somewhere in her heritage that grants her spells, bonus feats, an additional class skill, and other special abilities. This source can represent a blood relation or an extreme event involving a creature somewhere in the family's past. For example, a sorcerer might have a dragon as a distant relative or her grandfather might have signed a terrible contract with a devil. Regardless of the source, this influence manifests in a number of ways as the sorcerer gains levels. A sorcerer must pick one bloodline upon taking her first level of sorcerer. Once made, this choice cannot be changed.

name: Aberrant Bloodline
description: There is a taint in your blood, one that is alien and bizarre. You tend to think in odd ways, approaching problems from an angle that most would not expect. Over time, this taint manifests itself in your physical form. Class Skill: Knowledge (dungeoneering). Bonus Spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.jnlr9cuepka1l26e]{Enlarge Person} (3rd) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.nokru6mxk9p3r513]{See Invisibility} (5th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.m1rmcpcaixcpz9ib]{Tongues}(7th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.wralcmyi4tdcai24]{Black Tentacles} (9th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.66vvhyiy5q8yzbq2]{Feeblemind}(11th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.fxwycv6d7xwzua4t]{Veil} (13th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.q3st18udsalnyz5v]{Plane Shift} (15th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.blvetbc929cfx4m8]{Mind Blank} (17th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.n3lp01euzcdmtbw5]{Shapechange} (19th) Bonus Feats: @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.u7rGDZUL296QIuA0]{Combat Casting} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.711B9WNFgpdDKKf2]{Improved Disarm} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.ZmQkRk93nbHxsQSt]{Improved Grapple} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{Improved Initiative} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.2aTFNMs3pW6nUBlr]{Improved Unarmed Strike} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.iAbIGhm7T2OK9Brt]{Iron Will} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.2YuxcUNFMPNBpekG]{Silent Spell} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{Skill Focus} ( Knowledge [dungeoneering]) Bloodline Arcana: Whenever you cast a spell of the polymorph subschool, increase the duration of the spell by 50% (minimum 1 round). name: Abyssal Bloodline
description: Generations ago, a demon spread its filth into your heritage. While it does not manifest in all of your kin, for you it is particularly strong. You might sometimes have urges to chaos or evil, but your destiny (and alignment) is up to you. Class Skill: Knowledge (planes). This does not stack with any DR the creature might have. Bloodline Powers: While some would say that you are possessed, you know better. The demonic influence in your blood grows as you gain power. @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.K8t4QuJhu4yXPgGJ inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.Q0rRzB0zUWSPM3JC inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.asX1tCPLkhm2UiwQ inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.DuAcRnjBmOADOvj2 inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.nRASOVnnyC6FJRMV inline=true]

name: Arcane Bloodline
description: Your family has always been skilled in the eldritch art of magic. While many of your relatives were accomplished wizards, your powers developed without the need for study and practice. Class Skill: Knowledge (any one). Bonus Spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.llxrra87kbofmyhl]{Identify} (3rd) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.oylikodnyku2zewu]{Invisibility} (5th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.gmgwyjfpeuuc4t4o]{Dispel Magic} (7th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.ojwg1ki98tq8xyh9]{Dimension Door} (9th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.wqvy12w1xgk6l9b0]{Overland Flight} (11th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.jbqo4o2b2tmdz7wv]{True Seeing} (13th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.5cdmojmydhwowzy1]{Teleport, Greater} (15th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.ol9newf4vrcx0kpf]{Power Word Stun} (17th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.nnj51dwfkwd15ngj]{Wish} (19th) Bonus Feats: @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.u7rGDZUL296QIuA0]{Combat Casting} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.V8GIvVaAofyw9xIl]{Improved Counterspell} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{Improved Initiative} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.iAbIGhm7T2OK9Brt]{Iron Will} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.tlRu8SYjzA7WCHN7]{Scribe Scroll} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{Skill Focus} ( Knowledge [arcana]) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.V2zY7BltkpSXwejy]{Spell Focus} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.jVFjMIyQD6TOAsmj]{Still Spell} Bloodline Arcana: Whenever you apply a metamagic feat to a spell that increases the slot used by at least one level, increase the spell’s DC by +1. This bonus does not stack with itself and does not apply to spells modified by the @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.O109YFcItBFUDHvu]{Heighten Spell} feat. Bloodline Powers: Magic comes naturally to you, but as you gain levels you must take care to prevent the power from overwhelming you. @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.qgr0VkVJB3xgbbqd inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.EwV7Db8W6ww3rtd0 inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.0ZfpdepXs7JYw975 inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.WXKReSiAhaVMSIS2 inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.bS39nw77bwZkH8KQ inline=true]

name: Celestial Bloodline
description: Your bloodline is blessed by a celestial power, either from a celestial ancestor or through divine intervention. Although this power drives you along the path of good, your fate (and alignment) is your own to determine. Class Skill: Heal. This does not stack with any DR the creature might have. Bloodline Powers: Your celestial heritage grants you a great many powers, but they come at a price. The lords of the higher planes are watching you and your actions closely. @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.Z2zeMoT94hK5jkCx inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.DuEqvGxKmWHYxQYf inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.IcChR6pf8RMqs4yK inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.vaFFJInxDUOQmIsz inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.KR6Hhz4S7ZIegQCx inline=true]

name: Destined Bloodline
description: Your family is destined for greatness in some way. Your birth could have been foretold in prophecy, or perhaps it occurred during an especially auspicious event, such as a solar eclipse. Regardless of your bloodline’s origin, you have a great future ahead. Class Skill: Knowledge (history). Bloodline Powers: You are destined for great things, and the powers that you gain serve to protect you. @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.blBvtrBU3EmIqCq1 inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.f9UnZREQm2gTEE8Y inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.wv4zg1MAMyTeTzJ6 inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.ByK6tGzzELAxq67X inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.YbntgBHMSpzmZruX inline=true]

name: Draconic Bloodline
description: At some point in your family’s history, a dragon interbred with your bloodline, and now its ancient power flows through your veins. Class Skill: Perception . Bonus Spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.ucc0a31d1y86oleh]{Mage Armor} (3rd) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.tkjnm3lw7ni82tag]{Resist Energy} (5th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.7d6sv5ecvi7kho3m]{Fly} (7th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.be88e90guqbi1q1z]{Fear} (9th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.4k9bh8ny1il2oner]{Spell Resistance} (11th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.iqcjiyi9leldfzxt]{Form of the Dragon I} (13th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.5icj4nasrlgqojqm]{Form of the Dragon II} (15th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.6qpg42rj70oi4css]{Form of the Dragon III} (17th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.nnj51dwfkwd15ngj]{Wish} (19th) Bonus Feats: @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.pmAO1Sni8xx71pLF]{Blind-Fight} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.fVRnBIHR4Jq6btvm]{Great Fortitude} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{Improved Initiative} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.FUW5mIXHNBBIQ1Sq]{Power Attack} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.wFoLrh5FeeqBXsQ8]{Quicken Spell} @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{Skill Focus} ( Fly ) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{Skill Focus} ( Knowledge [arcana]) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.feats.8snLqsJN4LLL00Nq]{Toughness} Bloodline Arcana: Whenever you cast a spell with an energy descriptor that matches your draconic bloodline’s energy type, that spell deals +1 point of damage per die rolled. Bloodline Powers: The power of dragons flows through you and manifests in a number of ways. At 1st level, you must select one of the chromatic or metallic dragon types. This choice cannot be changed. A number of your abilities grant resistances and deal damage based on your dragon type, as noted on the following table. @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.CEjHiIRIDWGrJjMX inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.zRjCUXkADqaG0hXj inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.VH05vtasBdGaUaju inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.lqWarOs0RLAfT9tl inline=true] @Embed[Compendium.pf1.class-abilities.Item.4OmrOhnYAx5N5eEf inline=true]

name: Elemental Bloodline
description: The power of the elements resides in you, and at times you can hardly control its fury. This influence comes from an elemental outsider in your family history or a time when you or your relatives were exposed to a powerful elemental force. Class Skill: Knowledge (planes). Bonus Spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.lndeaqm2j2nvgm6p]{Burning Hands}* (3rd) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.q4ixxjb4v281g2xv]{Scorching Ray}* (5th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.1vh2ewwvzvxunoxk]{Protection from Energy} (7th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.pawbnw1nm4f0b98e]{Elemental Body I} (9th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.yldjnorgbx4jsldz]{Elemental Body II} (11th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.hd32fuc6e7j4isbn]{Elemental Body III} (13th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.v42t5kpxc8mvd615]{Elemental Body IV} (15th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.j91n23p4tfjixp3s]{Summon Monster VIII} (elementals only) (17th) @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.pfy97qyneoa391ek]{Elemental Swarm} (19th) *These spells always deal a type of damage determined by your element.
